# TPC-Havoc Q3_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  l_orderkey,
  SUM(l_extendedprice * (
    1 - l_discount
  )) AS revenue,
  o_orderdate,
  o_shippriority
FROM orders, lineitem
WHERE
  l_orderkey = o_orderkey
  AND o_orderdate < CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE)
  AND l_shipdate > CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE)
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM customer
    WHERE
      c_custkey = o_custkey AND c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  )
GROUP BY
  l_orderkey,
  o_orderdate,
  o_shippriority
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC,
  o_orderdate
```
